knowledge:
- key_parameters: object=An ExpressionSet object containing the gene expression data and phenotypic metadata ;; groups/group/classVar=The phenotypic variable (column name in pData) used to define sample groups for comparison or classification ;; probe2gene=Logical parameter indicating whether to map probe IDs to gene symbols in plots ;; n=Number of top features to return in topTable ;; reference=List specifying the control group (e.g., list(var="compound", level="DMSO")) in computeLogRatio ;; within=Character string specifying the blocking/grouping variable (e.g., time points) in computeLogRatio
- alternatives: limmaTwoLevels vs tTest=limmaTwoLevels uses a moderated t-test which is preferred for small sample sizes, whereas tTest performs an ordinary t-test (similar results when sample size is large) ;; Classifiers=PAM (pamClass), Random Forest (rfClass), Forward Filtering (nlcv/mcrPlot), and LASSO (lassoClass) are alternative classification approaches. Random Forest is noted as multivariate and dependent but can be unstable and overoptimistic ;; Pathway analysis=MLP (MLP package) is used as an alternative or supplement to standard GOstats/GSEA
- when_to_use: Appropriate for transcriptomic studies using Affymetrix microarrays (or similar expression data represented as an ExpressionSet) where the user wants to perform unsupervised exploration, filter out low-variance/low-intensity genes, identify differentially expressed genes, build classification models, and visualize gene expression profiles
- pitfalls: Many subsequent analysis functions rely on the presence of complementary annotation information in the ExpressionSet, which must be added first using addGeneInfo ;; Random Forest variable importance results can be unstable and sometimes overoptimistic; caution is advised during interpretation ;; Omit subtypes with only one sample (e.g., subtype T1 in the vignette) before computing log ratios or running differential expression to avoid statistical errors

workflows.name: microarray_differential_expression
workflows.intent: Perform unsupervised exploration, filter low-variance genes, detect differential expression using t-test or limma, and visualize results.
input: ExpressionSet (microarray expression data and phenotypic metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Add gene annotation ;; 2. Unsupervised exploration ;; 3. Filter genes based on variance and intensity ;; 4. Detect differential expression ;; 5. Visualize p-value distribution and estimate proportion of DE genes ;; 6. Extract top genes ;; 7. Visualize differential expression using volcano, box, and single-gene plots
workflows.code:
ALL <- addGeneInfo(ALL)
spectralMap(object = ALL, groups = "BT")
selBcrAblOrNeg <- filterVarInt(object = bcrAblOrNeg)
tTestResult <- tTest(selBcrAblOrNeg, "mol.biol")
histPvalue(tTestResult[,"p"], addLegend = TRUE)
propDEgenesRes <- propDEgenes(tTestResult[,"p"])
tabTTest <- topTable(tTestResult, n = 10)
volcanoPlot(tTestResult, topPValues = 5, topLogRatios = 5)
limmaResult <- limmaTwoLevels(selBcrAblOrNeg, "mol.biol")
volcanoPlot(limmaResult)
tabLimma <- topTable(limmaResult, n = 10, coef = 2)
tabAnnot <- annotationTable(displayData = dData, hrefData = hData)
plot1gene(probesetId = rownames(tTestResult)[1], object = selBcrAblOrNeg, groups = "mol.biol", legendPos = "topright")
boxPlot(probesetId = rownames(tTestResult)[1], object = selBcrAblOrNeg, boxwex = 0.3, groups = "mol.biol", colgroups = "BT", legendPos = "topright")

workflows.name: microarray_class_prediction
workflows.intent: Build and evaluate classification models using PAM, Random Forest, LASSO, and Logistic Regression to predict class membership and select predictive features.
workflows.stages: 1. Class prediction using PAM ;; 2. Class prediction using Random Forest ;; 3. Forward filtering with various classifiers ;; 4. Penalized regression using LASSO ;; 5. Logistic regression for a single gene ;; 6. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis
workflows.code:
resultPam <- pamClass(selBcrAblOrNeg, "mol.biol")
plot(resultPam)
featResultPam <- topTable(resultPam, n = 15)
resultRF <- rfClass(selBcrAblOrNeg, "mol.biol")
plot(resultRF, which = 2)
featResultRF <- topTable(resultRF, n = 15)
mcrPlot_TT <- mcrPlot(nlcvTT, plot = TRUE, optimalDots = TRUE, layout = TRUE, main = "t-test selection")
scoresPlot(nlcvTT, tech = "svm", nfeat = 2)
resultLasso <- lassoClass(object = bcrAblOrNeg, groups = "mol.biol")
plot(resultLasso, label = TRUE, main = "Lasso coefficients in relation to degree of penalization.")
featResultLasso <- topTable(resultLasso, n = 15)
logRegRes <- logReg(geneSymbol = "ABL1", object = bcrAblOrNeg, groups = "mol.biol")
probabilitiesPlot(proportions = logRegRes$fit, classVar = logRegRes$y, sampleNames = rownames(logRegRes), main = "Probability of being NEG")
ROCres <- ROCcurve(geneSymbol = "ABL1", object = bcrAblOrNeg, groups = "mol.biol")

workflows.name: log_ratio_analysis
workflows.intent: Compute and visualize log ratios of gene expression relative to a control or reference group across different conditions or time points.
input: ExpressionSet (containing treatment/control or time-course microarray data)
workflows.stages: 1. Compute log ratios relative to a reference level ;; 2. Plot log ratios for selected genes
workflows.code:
LogRatioALL <- computeLogRatio(ALL2, reference = list(var="BT", level="B"))
a <- plotLogRatio(e = LogRatioALL[topGenes,], openFile = FALSE, tooltipvalues = FALSE, device = "pdf", filename = "GeneLRlist", colorsColumnsBy = "BTtype", main = 'Top 20 genes most differentially between T- and B-cells', orderBy = list(rows = "hclust"), probe2gene = TRUE)
logRatioEset <- computeLogRatio(esetExampleTimeCourse, within = "hours", reference = list(var = "compound", level = "DMSO"))
plotLogRatio(e = logRatioEset, mx = 1, filename = "logRatioOverallTimeCourse.pdf", gene.fontsize = 8, orderBy = list(rows = "hclust", cols = NULL), colorsColumnsBy = c('compound'), within = "hours", shortvarnames = shortvarnames, exp.width = 1, main = paste("Differential Expression (trend at early time points) in", cl, "upon treatment with", compound), reference = list(var = "compound", level = "DMSO"), device = 'pdf')

workflows.name: pathway_enrichment_mlp
workflows.intent: Perform pathway enrichment analysis using the Mean Log P (MLP) method.
workflows.stages: 1. Generate p-values using limmaTwoLevels ;; 2. Map probe IDs to Entrez IDs ;; 3. Retrieve gene sets ;; 4. Run MLP analysis ;; 5. Plot the MLP results as a GO graph
workflows.code:
limmaResult <- limmaTwoLevels(object =  ALL, group = "BT2")
pValues <- limmaResult@MArrayLM$p.value
pValueNames <- fData(ALL)[rownames(pValues), 'ENTREZID']
pValues <- pValues[,2]
names(pValues) <- pValueNames
pValues <- pValues[!is.na(pValueNames)]
geneSet <- getGeneSets(species = "Human", geneSetSource = "GOBP", entrezIdentifiers = names(pValues))
mlpOut <- MLP(geneSet = geneSet, geneStatistic = pValues, minGenes = 5, maxGenes = 100, rowPermutations = TRUE, nPermutations = 50, smoothPValues = TRUE, probabilityVector = c(0.5, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99, 0.999, 0.9999, 0.99999), df = 9)
plot(mlpOut, type = "GOgraph", nRow = 25)
